S2 T1 dermatoid-brassy-junco LANDED as 9371328844 (Gerrit 1892, LLM-Review +1 + Verified +1, CI 32219790927 success) and CLOSED; unblocked T2. Implementer reported 1 attempt, and notably kept the non-literal os.environ.get read on line 109 EXACTLY - putting its new import on the existing from-import line and reflowing the docstring to the same line count - so docs/env-vars.md needed no regeneration in that slice. It also flagged that the config_ownership_exceptions.py rationale prose (L538/L110) is now stale by ~100 lines; the registry keys on path+symbol so that is cosmetic, and T2 corrects it while re-registering.
S2 T2 sportive-statued-goose: file_impact set FIRST (4 -> 6 paths: added scripts/config_ownership_exceptions.py and docs/adr/0099) and THEN review-plan run - PASS, signed, 0 blocking, only a P6 0.40 advisory. The coordinator's ordering advice worked exactly as intended: no self-inflicted staleness this time. CLAIMED.
Oracle authored: extended state/test_binding_lifecycle.py with 25 direct absence/tombstone/comment tests -> 25 RED on the new scaffold members, 26 green (T1's suite plus the repository-level fail-closed case). Existing FACADE coverage was inventoried first and deliberately not duplicated - test_binding_absence_lifecycle.py (8 tests: clear_absent reset, retire at grace, persistence across reload, corrupt-retired fail-open, corrupt-bindings fail-closed, malformed and overridden grace env) and test_binding_store_comment_ids.py (5 tests) remain the regression oracle; my new tests add the direct-module tier with both-index assertions and reload-through-the-repository, which the facade tests do not reach.
13 discriminators held out to /tmp/rp02-heldout/S2T2_FULL.py: clear_absent not dirtying a clean entry, unbound-key no-ops, the parametrized malformed-env defensive parse (abc/empty/1.5/-3, including the clamp-to-1 case), retire and unretire alert emission, unretire idempotency, tombstone ISOLATION when one of several is retired or lifted, comment-map no-save-churn on identical re-record, legacy-store-readable-without-rewrite, corrupt-retired fail-open with live state still usable, alert-write failure not breaking a retirement, and unknown-field survival on the wholesale-rewritten retired file. 9 visible.
Implementer brief carries the mandatory registry change front and centre: both binding_store.py rows must be re-registered under the binding_lifecycle.py path IN THE SAME CHANGE or make lint blocks the commit, with rationales stating the read is a moved legacy AMBIENT read (byte-identical sourcing) and that the seam cut remains RP-04 S7.3.a's slice tracked by best-kingly-monkey; plus ADR 0099's forward note updated to realized, and docs/env-vars.md regenerated since this move WILL shift the read's line.
